title: Silly Silly Modpack
description: A silly modpack for all your silly needs
body:
The silly silly modpack for all your silly needs. Made to play in singleplayer, as it has NOT been tested for multiplayer.

I made this modpack to play with some of my favourite mods, such as Farmers Delight, and Macaw's line of mods! silly silly modpack features some optimization mods to make the game run smoother, and Complementary Shaders. 

silly silly modpack is primarily a cozy farming modpack that you can just start up a world and get right into the silliness! The silliness could be as silly as just settling down and building or farming all the way to fighting the Ender Dragon!

In the versions, there are mod differences, but mods that were added/removed are detailed in the changelog of the version! PLEASE read those before choosing your version!
